shortTitle: AASM Adult OSA Diagnostic Testing Guideline
citation: Kapur VK, Auckley DH, Chowdhuri S, et al. Clinical practice guideline for diagnostic testing for adult obstructive sleep apnea: an American Academy of Sleep Medicine clinical practice guideline. J Clin Sleep Med. 2017;13(3):479-504.
currencyNote: The 2017 guideline remains the existing AASM adult OSA diagnostic-testing guideline, but AASM lists a focused update project as in development in 2026. Re-verify before production release and before relying on version-sensitive patient-selection details.
bestFor: Adult OSA diagnostic-testing pathway, when PSG versus HSAT is appropriate, technically adequate HSAT concepts, and escalation after negative/inconclusive/technically inadequate HSAT.

mappingRationale.D2B: Provides the clinical diagnostic-testing framework that should govern how HSAT technical guidance is interpreted during procedure-related study preparation and performance.

copyrightUse: Use citation, high-level recommendation topics, original summaries, and learning objectives. Do not reproduce substantial recommendation text, evidence tables, or protected material.
